title: Quote the instruction: writing each instruction into its step reduces misreading in small models
description: Small language models fine-tuned on step-by-step solutions often fail on problems that contain instructions they never saw in training: they drop the unfamiliar step or replace it with a familiar one. Writing each instruction into the step that carries it out raised held-out accuracy from 0.63 to 0.91 (Qwen2.5-1.5B) and from 0.07 to 0.48 (SmolLM-1.7B). Each experiment's predictions and scoring were committed before it ran.
